sections.overview: This hylid treefrog occurs in Brazil, Paraguay, Bolivia and northern Argentina.
sections.identification: The Paraguayan fauna guide describes a pointed snout, rough pustular back and a total length of up to about 45 mm.
sections.habitat: It is reported from open, vegetated places near water, including areas around homes.
sections.diet: The concise species accounts consulted do not establish a species-specific diet.
sections.behavior: The Paraguayan guide describes it as arboreal and sometimes present in peridomestic environments.
sections.reproduction: A reproductive study found continuous spermatogenesis in males and females with oocytes at different stages of maturity.
sections.ecology: The 2023 review places it in the Scinax rostratus group.
sections.conservation: The sources used here document its broad range but do not establish a current population trend.
